messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 9):
"""
It may be noted that Addon details need not be mentioned again but only the financial projections are to be filed, when the same Add-on is offered along with the second or the third product. (c) All items in the Form must be furnished with the relevant details. (d) The Appointed Actuary shall initial on all the pages of the IRDAI-HIP application form. NOTE: FOR THE PURPOSE OF THIS APPLICATION ADD-ON INCLUDES RIDERS OFFERED BY LIFE INSURERS. I. Form: IRDAI –-HIP [All the items should be filled in properly and carefully. No item must be left blank.] S No Item Particulars (to be filled in by insurer) Section I:
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"If an insurer offers the same add‑on with multiple health insurance products, do they need to restate the add‑on details in each application?","answer":"No, the insurer only needs to file the financial projections for the add‑on; the add‑on details do not need to be restated for the second or third product.","facts":["\"Addon details need not be mentioned again but only the financial projections are to be filed, when the same Add‑on is offered along with the second or the third product.\""]},{"question":"Who is required to initial every page of the IRDAI‑HIP application form?","answer":"The appointed actuary must initial all pages of the application form.","facts":["\"The Appointed Actuary shall initial on all the pages of the IRDAI‑HIP application form.\""]}]}
